descriptions.sol35f9_binary_tree_hint_8035b594: Use a bidirectional iterator hint in the observed GC32 ordered tree of pointer-backed 16-byte keys. Compare with the witnessed memcmp, check leftmost/end/interior positions, use valid adjacent gaps, preserve equivalent entries and otherwise forward to unique insertion. Iterator and result return ABI, traversal, insertion and comparison targets come from original instructions. Names/STL identities inferred; valid tree/key lifetimes and external node construction remain preconditions.
